utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning all, you alright? Quick one today, Thursday 08 January. Let's get round it.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Morning. Bit rough after the football last night, to be honest. Absolute robbery.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Here we go.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: You say that every time your lot lose.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: No, no, genuinely, that ref was shocking.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Save it for break, Jamie. Also, don't forget the charity bake sale on Friday. Bring cash, and no, I'm not accepting 'forgot my wallet' again.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I've already had three emails about brownies, so it's clearly the main production priority.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Critical path item, that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, actual plant. Any overnight issues?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Nothing major from quality. I noticed the gas valve on one was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down, so just an observation, not asking for anything on it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, noted. Same from me, I heard a slight rattle from the alarm box, nothing to action yet, just keep an ear on it if you're passing.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Alarm history looked clean when I checked this morning, no weird trips.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And just so it's said, I tested the HRSG yesterday and it's all fine now, so that's done, not for today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Cheers. Anything still blocked, we've still got the usual one: still waiting on parts for the GT1 Fuel Gas Valve, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, dead in the water on that till stores actually sees the bits.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Oi, not me this time. Supplier side.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I signed into the trend packs before this, no fresh alarms off GT1 anyway.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine. Hannah, you had line stuff?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah. I signed off the inspection on the line 2 on Tuesday, so that's closed out already.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Keep that one buried then.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Schedule-wise today is mostly tidy apart from the Engel work if we can get the paperwork straight.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, on that, I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the Engel by Thursday. I'll pick that up myself so nobody else chase it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: By Thursday this week, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, by Thursday. I'll own it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I'll mark boss against that then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Next one, Priya, can you check the guarding on the Line 2 Pick and Place Robot next week? I want a proper look, not just a glance walking past.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, Priya can do that. I'll check the guarding on the Line 2 Pick and Place Robot next week and feed back if anything's out.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Good shout after the near miss chat.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Which brings me to that, Han, can you write up the near miss at the pick and place on two?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll do it. I'll write up the near miss at the pick and place on two today once I've pulled the witness notes together.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice one.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: While we're on rotating kit, I'll take vibration readings on the GT2 Number 2 Bearing by the end of the week. I was over there yesterday and I'd rather get a baseline before it drifts.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Makes sense. Trend it against the last set if you can.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll grab the old numbers.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, thanks PR.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Pricey, can you grease and check the bearings on the old turbine tomorrow at 9:30?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Me?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Quality doing bearings, that's a new one.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I know, but yeah alright. I can grease and check the bearings on the old turbine tomorrow at 9:30 if that's what we need.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: It is, cheers. Just need it covered and you're nearest skill-wise when Tom's tied up.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Fine, put it in. I'll rope someone in if I need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, whenever you get a chance, can you inspect the turbine two water valve for leaks?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, no problem. I'll inspect the turbine two water valve for leaks whenever I get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: No hard deadline on that one, just fit around stores?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly, whenever you get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, got it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tommo, can you order spare parts for the Waste Heat Boiler today at 2pm?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Order them, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, order spare parts for the Waste Heat Boiler today at 2pm. Need the request out.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Alright, Tommo's got it. I'll order spare parts for the Waste Heat Boiler today at 2pm.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: If it's through the usual supplier, shout me, I've got the account ref sat there.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah send it over after this.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Anything on controls side before I disappear into cabinets?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Not much. Just keep an eye on the alarm box noise, but again, not an action, just observation for now.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I've got contractor slots free this afternoon, but if the Engel permit isn't sorted they won't touch it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood, that's on me. I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the Engel by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: For the near miss write-up, do you want just the event summary or full corrective actions draft as well?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Start with the event summary. Write up the near miss at the pick and place on two and we'll add actions after review.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, Han will do that.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: On the Line 2 Pick and Place Robot, do you want interlocks checked as part of the guarding review or literally physical guarding?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Start with the physical guarding on the Line 2 Pick and Place Robot. If the interlocks look suspect, flag it, but the agreed job is the guarding check next week.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Understood.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That old turbine bearing job, Hannah, if you want a grease gun that's not ancient, nick mine.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Cheers. If I'm doing the old turbine tomorrow at 9:30 I'd prefer one that actually pumps.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Luxury.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: We are moving up in the world.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Can I just read back so I don't get grief later?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Go on.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Boss is to sort the permit to work and isolation for the Engel by Thursday. Priya is to check the guarding on the Line 2 Pick and Place Robot next week. Pricey is to grease and check the bearings on the old turbine tomorrow at 9:30. PR will take vibration readings on the GT2 Number 2 Bearing by the end of the week. Jamie will inspect the turbine two water valve for leaks whenever you get a chance. Tommo will order spare parts for the Waste Heat Boiler today at 2pm. Han will write up the near miss at the pick and place on two.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's it, exactly.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: All good from me.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Fine by me.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorted.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anything else, actual anything else, not football?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: No, but seriously, if anyone's baking for Friday, no raisins pretending to be chocolate chips.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: That's a quality issue, to be fair.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, off you go then.
